about_the_game:
This demo of The Left Eye contains the entirety of episode one.

  • An LGBTQ crime-capering romance set in the roaring twenties

  • Script by award-winning stage & TV writer Conway McDermott

  • Developed by an indie team of approximately three queers in a trenchcoat

  • Ten hand-drawn CGs

  • Original arrangements of jazz standards

  • A full episode with a wordcount of around 12000

  • Don't worry about making bad decisions, just enjoy the consequences - for now. This demo is mostly linear, but you never know what might come back to haunt you...

  • Be gay

  • Do crime

content_descriptors.notes: This demo contains mature themes, including strong language, criminal activity, period-specific bigotry and homophobic slurs, use of alcohol, and depictions of violence. Use of slurs can be censored via the settings menu.

short_description: A honey-trapping, backstabbing, high-stakes story with a romantic heart, featuring problematic gays to suit a variety of bad tastes. Set in 1920s New York, this demo follows an audacious conman juggling friends, enemies, and the most outrageous scam he’s ever tried to pull.
